action_or_input: Invalid or unauthorized actions are rejected without committing an invalid business-state change; specific exceptions are listed in Alternative Flows where source-supported.
expected_result: No unauthorized or invalid business-state change is committed; existing valid records and previously recorded history remain intact.

purpose: Verify the main success scenario for Activate Approved Deregistration.
preconditions: A deregistration request is in Approved — Awaiting Effective Date state.
action_or_input: 1. The next calendar day after approval begins.2. MMS identifies approved deregistration requests whose service effect is due.3. MMS makes the deregistration effective for mess service.4. MMS records the resulting lifecycle state/history.
expected_result: The Student is deregistered for mess service from the next calendar day, as required by the frozen PS.

purpose: Verify the explicitly specified alternative flow A1 for Activate Approved Deregistration.
preconditions: A deregistration request is in Approved — Awaiting Effective Date state.
action_or_input: If the request is no longer eligible for the transition because its state has validly changed, MMS does not apply the transition.
expected_result: If the request is no longer eligible for the transition because its state has validly changed, MMS does not apply the transition.

purpose: Verify the exception guarantee for Activate Approved Deregistration.
preconditions: A deregistration request is in Approved — Awaiting Effective Date state.
action_or_input: A processing failure shall not create a partial or contradictory registration state; the previously recorded approval remains available for recovery.
expected_result: The approved request and prior registration state remain recorded consistently until the event-triggered transition can be completed.

purpose: Verify the main success scenario for Apply Default Vacation Response at Deadline.
preconditions: The survey exists; a response deadline was set; one or more currently registered Students have no recorded response.
action_or_input: 1. The survey response deadline is reached.2. MMS identifies currently registered Students with no recorded response.3. MMS records No as the default response for each such Student.4. MMS makes the defaulted responses available in the survey response summary.
expected_result: Each applicable non-responding registered Student has a recorded default No response.

purpose: Verify the explicitly specified alternative flow A1 for Apply Default Vacation Response at Deadline.
preconditions: The survey exists; a response deadline was set; one or more currently registered Students have no recorded response.
action_or_input: Students with an explicit Yes or No response are left unchanged.
expected_result: Students with an explicit Yes or No response are left unchanged.

purpose: Verify the explicitly specified alternative flow A2 for Apply Default Vacation Response at Deadline.
preconditions: The survey exists; a response deadline was set; one or more currently registered Students have no recorded response.
action_or_input: If no registered Student lacks a response, no default response record is created.
expected_result: If no registered Student lacks a response, no default response record is created.

purpose: Verify the exception guarantee for Apply Default Vacation Response at Deadline.
preconditions: The survey exists; a response deadline was set; one or more currently registered Students have no recorded response.
action_or_input: A processing failure shall not overwrite explicit responses or create duplicate response records.
expected_result: Existing explicit responses remain unchanged and valid.

purpose: Verify the main success scenario for Default-Reject Undecided Special Food Request.
preconditions: A special-food request exists in Requested state and no Caretaker decision has been recorded within the stipulated period.
action_or_input: 1. The stipulated decision period expires.2. MMS verifies that the request remains Requested and undecided.3. MMS changes the request state to Rejected (Default).4. MMS records the lifecycle/history update.5. MMS triggers the rejection-outcome notification to the Student.
expected_result: The undecided request is Rejected (Default) and the rejection outcome is recorded/notified.

purpose: Verify the explicitly specified alternative flow A1 for Default-Reject Undecided Special Food Request.
preconditions: A special-food request exists in Requested state and no Caretaker decision has been recorded within the stipulated period.
action_or_input: If the Caretaker has already approved or rejected the request, MMS does not perform the default rejection.
expected_result: If the Caretaker has already approved or rejected the request, MMS does not perform the default rejection.

purpose: Verify the exception guarantee for Default-Reject Undecided Special Food Request.
preconditions: A special-food request exists in Requested state and no Caretaker decision has been recorded within the stipulated period.
action_or_input: A processing failure shall not create both an explicit and a default decision for the same request.
expected_result: The request remains in its last valid state with no duplicate decision.

purpose: Verify the main success scenario for Generate Monthly Mess Bills.
preconditions: Served-day data, approved special-meal/add-on charges, and approved rebate deductions applicable to the billing month are available in MMS.
action_or_input: 1. The monthly billing event occurs for the applicable calendar month.2. MMS determines served-day charges using the applicable daily-rate input.3. MMS includes approved special-meal/add-on charges.4. MMS applies approved rebate deductions.5. MMS generates the monthly bill records in Generated state for Caretaker review.
expected_result: Monthly bill records exist in Generated state and are available to the Caretaker for review/finalization/publication through MMS-UC-010.

purpose: Verify the explicitly specified alternative flow A1 for Generate Monthly Mess Bills.
preconditions: Served-day data, approved special-meal/add-on charges, and approved rebate deductions applicable to the billing month are available in MMS.
action_or_input: If required bill-input data is unavailable, MMS does not mark the affected bill as ready for Caretaker finalization.
expected_result: If required bill-input data is unavailable, MMS does not mark the affected bill as ready for Caretaker finalization.

purpose: Verify the exception guarantee for Generate Monthly Mess Bills.
preconditions: Served-day data, approved special-meal/add-on charges, and approved rebate deductions applicable to the billing month are available in MMS.
action_or_input: A computation or data-access failure shall not publish an incomplete or unfinalized bill.
expected_result: No incomplete bill is published; source billing data remains unchanged.

purpose: Verify the main success scenario for Send Vacation Survey Reminder.
preconditions: A vacation food-continuity survey exists and is open for currently registered Students.
action_or_input: 1. A reminder event occurs for the open survey.2. MMS identifies the applicable currently registered Students.3. MMS triggers the system-generated survey reminder email through the external email infrastructure.
expected_result: The MMS reminder event has been triggered for the applicable survey recipients.

purpose: Verify the explicitly specified alternative flow A1 for Send Vacation Survey Reminder.
preconditions: A vacation food-continuity survey exists and is open for currently registered Students.
action_or_input: If the survey is no longer open, MMS does not trigger an open-survey reminder.
expected_result: If the survey is no longer open, MMS does not trigger an open-survey reminder.

purpose: Verify the exception guarantee for Send Vacation Survey Reminder.
preconditions: A vacation food-continuity survey exists and is open for currently registered Students.
action_or_input: External email-delivery failure handling is outside MMS scope unless separately specified.
expected_result: Survey and response records remain unchanged.
